parameters.query:
select litellm_model, temperature, max_tokens, nudge,
       price_in_usd_per_1k, price_out_usd_per_1k, impact
from model_routing
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and modality = $2 and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Call LiteLLM
nodes.notes: Multimodal (ADR-036 Block 5): messages now comes from Resolve Routing (content array with optional image_url parts). onError=continueErrorOutput: a non-2xx routes to Fallback to Opus (ADR-037).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ model: $json.litellm_model, messages: $json.messages, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens }, $json.temperature != null ? { temperature: $json.temperature } : {})) }}

nodes.name: Call Log Model Run
nodes.notes: ADR-035: the shared agent_runs writer also owns cost math (FX, PLN, token-price fallback). Returns cost_pln_total + cost_missing.

value.message: Degradacja w Invoke Model: fallback na Opus (model podstawowy zawiódł), routing fail-safe, i/lub brak danych o koszcie.
value.details: =fell_back_to_opus={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.fell_back_to_opus }}; routing_default_used={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.routing_default_used }}; routing_row_missing={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.routing_row_missing }}; cost_missing={{ $('Call Log Model Run').first().json.cost_missing }}; impact={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.impact }}; model={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.model_used }}; task={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.clickup_task_id }}

nodes.name: Fallback to Opus
nodes.notes: Auto-fallback (ADR-037): primary model call failed -> retry once on Opus, to opus-4-8-direct. Uses the same multimodal messages from Resolve Routing (ADR-036 Block 5). Success feeds Parse Response with fell_back=true -> WARN. If Opus ALSO fails it throws -> Execute LLM Call CRITICAL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'haxe-opus-4-8-direct', messages: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.messages, max_tokens: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.max_tokens }) }}

nodes.name: Routing Missing?
nodes.notes: 0-row routing guard: true when Lookup Routing matched nothing and Resolve Routing fell back to its safety-net model (routing_row_missing). True -> CRITICAL alert. Both branches reconverge to Check Degradation so Shape Output stays the sole leaf (sub-workflow return determinism).

nodes.name: Alert Routing Missing
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): the model_routing table has no row for this impact/modality/PD combo. The run still replies via Resolve Routing's safety-net model, so this is loud-but-non-blocking. Reconverges to Check Degradation (not a leaf).

value.message: Brak trasy w model_routing dla tej kombinacji (impact × modalność) — użyto modelu zapasowego. Uzupełnij model_routing.
value.details: =task={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; impact={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.impact }}; modalność={{ $('When Called').first().json.modality }}; model_zapasowy={{ $('Parse Response').first().json.model_used }}
